title: 第7章 水火麒麟献殷勤灵宝感应显神通第8章 混沌始源再进化通天推算遇难关
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
相传道祖鸿钧成圣之后，曾传道天下，于紫霄宫之中讲道！迎来三千红尘客！
在第三次，鸿钧讲圣人之道后，收六徒，正好先天灵根先天葫芦藤成熟，道祖就将众宝分给了众人！
鸿蒙灵根葫芦藤，作为天地间最古老的灵根之一，自诞生之日起便承载着大道的本源与法则，每一颗葫芦都蕴含着无上的智慧与强横的力量。
其上结着七颗不同的葫芦，每一件都是强大的极品先天灵宝！
此刻，林镜手中的正是那七颗葫芦中通天教主得到的那一颗——紫黄色【水火葫芦】！
【叮！恭喜宿主获得极品先天灵宝——【水火葫芦】，触发收集任务《一根藤七个瓜》！请在巫妖大劫开始之前，集齐全部七种至宝葫芦！完成任务奖励本源恢复3%！】
当那一张封印符纸被林镜撕下去时，系统的声音就接连传来！
【水火葫芦】也在顷刻间就和林镜完成了炼化，直接就认主了！
林镜现在还不知道他的本体【混沌始源镜】所代表的到底是什么，只是感叹炼化灵宝还真的简单！
【水火葫芦】中所召唤的水火麒麟算得上是一种先天器灵，并不是真正的生灵！
但是自从【水火葫芦】认主之后，林镜就和这两只小麒麟有了特殊的感应，它们似乎特别喜欢自己！
站在一旁的多宝道人已经愣了半天了，他没想到这两只平时桀骜不驯的水火麒麟竟然会这么听话！
他本来都已经撸起袖子，准备出手压制这两只麒麟了！
不过现在看着师弟弯腰抚摸两只变小的麒麟的样子，似乎这个场景也十分不错嘛！
“师弟啊！我现在是越来越看不懂你的本事了！这两只家伙怎么会这么听你的话呢？”
身为由极品先天灵宝所凝聚而成的水火麒麟之器灵，其地位尊崇无比，平日里唯有听从通天教主一人之令罢了。
至于那些普通弟子们所说之言，对它们而言简直如同耳旁风一般，毫无作用可言！
正是由于此等缘由，使得通天教主始终未曾将这件稀世罕见的极品先天至宝赐予任何一名弟子。
要知道，对于那些已然拥有超凡实力的杰出弟子来说，他们本身便已具备了足以应对各种挑战的能力，如此珍贵的法宝于他们而言并无太大必要；
然而，反观那些实力稍逊一筹的弟子们，则完全无法驾驭得了这对水火麒麟，即便勉强得到，恐怕也难以发挥出其应有的威力，反而会适得其反！

多宝道人心中暗自思忖着：“难道真如我所猜测那般，竟是师尊近些年来教导有方，使得这水火麒麟已然被驯服得服服帖帖、乖巧异常了么？”
这般想着，他不禁心生好奇与疑惑，决定亲自上前去试探一番。
于是乎，他大踏步地朝着那已经缩小身形的火麒麟走去，眼中闪烁着跃跃欲试的光芒，仿佛想要验证自己内心的想法是否属实。
然而，就在他刚刚伸出手准备触摸那可爱小巧的火麒麟时，异变陡生！
只见原本安静温顺的火麒麟瞬间变得凶猛无比，它猛地转过头来，那双燃烧着熊熊烈焰的眼睛死死地盯着多宝道人，口中更是发出一声震耳欲聋的咆哮声。
紧接着，它张开血盆大口，露出尖锐锋利的獠牙，毫不犹豫地向多宝道人的手臂狠狠地咬去！
好在多宝道人反应迅速，身手敏捷。察觉到危险来临的刹那间，他便以迅雷不及掩耳之势将手急速抽回。
尽管如此，那火麒麟凌厉的攻势还是让他惊出一身冷汗。望着眼前依旧张牙舞爪、凶神恶煞般的火麒麟，多宝道人无奈地摇了摇头，心中暗暗叹气道：
“果然不出我所料，水火麒麟还是十分凶猛的！”
以他目前所拥有的强大实力而言，就算此刻选择直面这只凶猛无比的火麒麟而不躲闪逃避，它也根本无法对其造成任何实质性的伤害。
然而，如果就这样硬生生地挨上那么一下狠咬，那疼痛肯定也是真疼的！
如此这般想来，反倒让林镜看起来愈发不同凡响了！果真是我的好师弟啊，实在是太厉害了！
可林镜万万没有料到，这只在自己目前乖巧可爱的火麒麟居然会如此调皮捣蛋，他当即毫不客气地大声呵斥道：
content_en:
According to legend, after Taoist ancestor Hongjun became a saint, he preached to the world and preached in Zixiao Palace! We welcome three thousand mortal guests!
In the third time, after Hongjun taught the way of saints, he accepted six disciples. Just as the innate spiritual roots and the innate gourd vine were mature, Taozu distributed the treasures to everyone!
The Hongmeng Spiritual Root Gourd Vine, as one of the oldest spiritual roots in the world, has carried the origin and laws of the avenue since its birth. Each gourd contains supreme wisdom and tyrannical power.
There are seven different gourds on it, each one is a powerful and top-grade innate spiritual treasure!
At this moment, what Lin Jing was holding was the one that Master Tongtian had obtained among the seven gourds - the purple-yellow [Water and Fire Gourd]!
【bite! Congratulations to the host for obtaining the best innate spiritual treasure - [Water and Fire Gourd], triggering the collection mission "One Vine and Seven Melons"! Please collect all seven kinds of treasure gourds before the Lich Tribulation begins! Completing the task will reward you with 3% source recovery! 】
When the sealing talisman was torn off by Lin Jing, the system's sounds came one after another!
[Water and Fire Gourd] also completed the refining process with Lin Jing in an instant, and immediately accepted it as its master!
Lin Jing still doesn't know what his body [Chaos Origin Mirror] represents, but he just sighs that refining spiritual treasures is really easy!
The water and fire unicorn summoned in [Water and Fire Gourd] can be regarded as an innate weapon spirit, not a real living being!
But ever since [Water and Fire Gourd] recognized its owner, Lin Jing had a special connection with these two little unicorns, and they seemed to particularly like him!
Taoist Duobao standing aside has been stunned for a long time. He did not expect that these two usually unruly water and fire unicorns would be so obedient!
He had already rolled up his sleeves and was ready to suppress these two unicorns!
But now looking at the junior brother bending down to caress the two smaller unicorns, it seems that this scene is also very good!
"Junior brother! I can't understand your skills anymore! How can these two guys listen to you so much?"
As a water-fire unicorn weapon spirit condensed from the best innate spiritual treasures, its status is extremely respected. On weekdays, it can only obey the orders of the Tongtian Cult Leader.
As for the words spoken by ordinary disciples, they are simply deaf to the wind and have no effect at all!
It is precisely because of these reasons that the leader of Tongtian has never given this rare and top-quality innate treasure to any of his disciples.
You must know that for those outstanding disciples who already have extraordinary strength, they themselves have the ability to cope with various challenges, and such precious magic weapons are not very necessary for them;
However, on the other hand, those disciples who are slightly less powerful are completely unable to control the pair of water and fire unicorns. Even if they reluctantly obtain them, they may not be able to exert their due power, and it will be counterproductive!
Taoist Duobao thought to himself: "Is it true that as I guessed, it is Master's teachings in recent years that have made this water-fire unicorn tame and become obedient and well-behaved?"
Thinking like this, he couldn't help but feel curious and doubtful, and decided to go and test it himself.
As a result, he strode towards the shrinking Huo Qilin, his eyes flashing with eagerness, as if he wanted to verify whether his inner thoughts were true.
However, just when he stretched out his hand to touch the cute and compact fire unicorn, a sudden change occurred!
I saw that the originally quiet and docile Fire Qilin suddenly became extremely ferocious. It suddenly turned its head, staring at Taoist Duobao with its eyes burning with blazing flames, and let out a deafening roar from its mouth.
Immediately afterwards, it opened its bloody mouth, exposed its sharp and sharp fangs, and bit hard at Taoist Duobao's arm without hesitation!
Fortunately, Taoist Duobao responded quickly and was agile. The moment he sensed the approaching danger, he acted with lightning speedHe quickly pulled his hand back as he covered his ears.
Despite this, the fierce attack of the Fire Qilin still made him break out in a cold sweat. Looking at the fire unicorn that was still showing its teeth and claws with a fierce look in front of him, Taoist Duobao shook his head helplessly and sighed secretly in his heart:
"As expected, the water and fire unicorn is still very ferocious!"
With the powerful strength he currently possesses, even if he chooses to face this extremely ferocious fire unicorn without dodging or escaping, it will not be able to cause any substantial harm to him.
However, if you receive such a hard bite like this, the pain must be really painful!
Thinking about it this way, it made Lin Jing look even more extraordinary! He is really my good junior brother, he is so awesome!
But Lin Jing never expected that this fire unicorn, which was cute and cute at the moment, would be so naughty and mischievous. He immediately scolded loudly and unceremoniously:
